```yaml
name: Pre-commit Execute

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: 'Pull Request Number'
        required: true
        type: number
      sha:
        description: 'Commit SHA to run pre-commit on'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  run-pre-commit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.sha }}
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pre-commit

      - name: Run pre-commit
        id: precommit
        run: |
          pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Commit changes
        if: steps.precommit.outcome == 'failure'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          git commit -m "chore: apply pre-commit fixes" || exit 0
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/temp-precommit-fix-${{ github.run_id }}

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.precommit.outcome == 'failure'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: apply pre-commit fixes"
          title: "chore: apply pre-commit fixes"
          body: "This PR was automatically created by the pre-commit bot to apply formatting and linting fixes."
          branch: temp-precommit-fix-${{ github.run_id }}
          base: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
          delete-branch: true
```
